description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_nonuniform_1d/rules/central_D2_nonuniform_zero_flux_bc. Every binding loads fixture.esm (N bound to 8 at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: the compound D(D(u,x),x) replaced by the rule's makearray (interior conservative flux-difference stencil aggregate over [2,7]; zero-flux one-sided faces at i=1 and i=8), zero apply_expression_template nodes (the two grid geometry templates the observeds xc and dxw apply to the 9-node edge array xe are fully inlined), zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, zero surviving metaparameter names, with the free-name geometry arrays xc and dxw surviving as index references and the x_nodes axis folded to size 9. This exercises the grid's edge-array contract: a metaparameter-expression index-set size (N+1) and apply_expression_template inside observeds. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
